description: Get a review's structured medical metadata as JSON: review dates (datePublished/dateModified/lastReviewed — a freshness signal absent from the Markdown), the intervention as a typed `about` entity with alternate names, and an ordered `citation` list of primary sources (each with a PubMed `pmid` when available). Use when you need the review's freshness, machine-readable references/PMIDs, or drug classification rather than prose.

slug.description: Review slug, e.g. 'rapamycin' (a full evipedia.ai URL is also accepted)

name: get_metadata
